reviews.author: Marcy T.
reviews.text: The view of the harbor from our room was incredible at sunrise. Staff at the front desk were warm and helpful. We will be back.

reviews.author: Dan R.
reviews.text: Room smelled musty and the carpet felt damp. Breakfast was just packaged muffins and weak coffee. Disappointing for the price.

reviews.author: Priya S.
reviews.text: Comfortable bed and a quiet room. Location is walkable to the docks. Breakfast could use more hot options.

reviews.author: Kevin M.
reviews.text: Front desk was friendly but check in took a while. Room was clean enough. Thin walls, we could hear the hallway.

reviews.author: Laura B.
reviews.text: Booked a lakeview room and got a parking lot view. The bathroom had mold in the corner. Nobody answered the desk phone.

reviews.author: Tomasz K.
reviews.text: Cozy inn with real Northern Michigan charm. Housekeeping was thorough. Wifi dropped a few times in the evening.

reviews.author: Angela P.
reviews.text: Best breakfast on the lakeshore, the fresh cinnamon rolls were a highlight. Rooms were spotless. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Rob D.
reviews.text: Parking was a nightmare, only a few spots for a full inn. The room was dated and the heater rattled all night.

reviews.author: Sam W.
reviews.text: Solid stay. Staff were kind and the lobby coffee was a nice touch. The bed was a little firm but we slept fine.

reviews.author: Nina F.
reviews.text: Loved the harbor location and the walk to dinner. Room was clean and quiet. Would stay again.

reviews.author: Grant H.
reviews.text: The breakfast area was crowded and out of food by eight. Our room was fine but a bit tired.

reviews.author: Elise V.
reviews.text: Front desk went above and beyond to get us a late checkout. Beautiful views and a clean, comfortable room.

reviews.author: Owen J.
reviews.text: Good location right by the water. Wifi was slow for work calls but the room was comfortable and quiet.

reviews.author: Cara L.
reviews.text: Noisy neighbors until two in the morning and the front desk did nothing. The room was not cleaned properly, trash still in the bin.

reviews.author: Miguel A.
reviews.text: Great value for a harbor town in season. Comfortable beds. Parking is tight but we managed.

reviews.author: Beth C.
reviews.text: Nice stay. The location by the water is the main draw. Room was a touch dated but clean and well kept.

reviews.author: Iris N.
reviews.text: The heater did not work and it was a cold night. Staff apologized but could not move us. Breakfast was minimal.

reviews.author: Jamal O.
reviews.text: Wonderful stay, walkable to everything, a spotless room, and the sunset over the harbor was unreal.

reviews.author: Holly G.
reviews.text: Good location and friendly staff. The walls are a little thin so you hear the hallway. Breakfast was fine.

reviews.author: Pete S.
reviews.text: Clean, quiet, and a short walk to the marina. The morning coffee and pastries were a nice touch.

reviews.author: guest4471
reviews.text: Absolutely the best hotel in Northern Michigan, amazing staff and perfect rooms, five stars all the way!

reviews.author: guest8820
reviews.text: Absolutely the best hotel in Northern Michigan, amazing staff and perfect rooms, five stars for sure!

reviews.author: guest5567
reviews.text: This is the best hotel in Northern Michigan, amazing staff and perfect rooms, easily five stars!
